title: GET /meta advertises the server, its capabilities and its keepalive
notes: The `server` member is free-form, so it is not asserted: every other byte is exact. The reference server writes this body with `serde_json::to_string`, which is the canonical form of CANONICAL.md. `wire_versions` is a list with the one version in it. A path that is not `/meta` answers 404.
